risk_flags.description: The contract explicitly leaves the lower-level write path able to accept unknown categories, so any non-CLI caller could still create invalid expense records. That may undercut the requirement that expenses use the known category set if `store.add_expense` is a public or reused write API.
risk_flags.span: No changes to validation logic inside `store.add_expense` — validation is added at the CLI layer in `cmd_add`

verdict.primary_risk: Validation only at the CLI layer may leave other write paths able to persist invalid categories.
